key.name: window-app-configs
key.description: JSON containing the list of WM_CLASS and their restoration settings.

key.name: window-app-states
key.description: JSON containing the last saved dimensions and positions for each WM_CLASS.

key.name: known-wm-classes
key.description: List of WM_CLASSes seen by the extension.

key.name: known-window-titles
key.description: List of window titles seen by the extension (used for pickers in prefs).

key.name: prefs-highlight-target
key.summary: Pending rule to highlight in Preferences
key.description: JSON identifying a window-app-configs rule to auto-expand next time Preferences opens.

key.name: capture-state-request
key.description: JSON identifying a window-app-configs rule whose matching window should have its current geometry/state snapshotted into window-app-states.

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Whether to show an icon in the top bar for quick access to Deja Window settings and to toggle its functionality on/off.

key.name: functionality-enabled
key.description: Whether window tracking/restoring/saving is active. Toggled from the top bar indicator without disabling the extension itself.

key.name: window-global-defaults
key.default: '{ "enabled": false, "restore_size": false, "restore_pos": false, "restore_maximized": false, "restore_workspace": false, "switch_to_workspace": false, "restore_minimized": false, "restore_above": false, "restore_sticky": false, "avoid_overlap": true, "excluded_apps": [] }'
key.description: JSON object of restore_* flags applied to any NORMAL window without its own per-app config, plus an excluded_apps list of rules like {"wm_class": pattern, "match_mode": "wm_class"|"title", "is_regex": bool}.
